Mykhailo Albertovych Fedorov [ b ] (born 21 January 1991) [ 2 ] is a Ukrainian politician who served as the Minister of Defence of Ukraine from January to July 2026, when he was dismissed from office by President Zelenskyy . [ 3 ] [ 4 ]
On 15 July 2026, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy dismissed Fedorov from his position as Defence Minister after serving six months in office. [ 56 ] [ 57 ] The dismissal came the day after Ukraine’s parliament accepted the resignation of prime minister Yulia Svyrydenko [ 58 ] and prompted public protests in Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities, with demonstrators calling for Fedorov’s reinstatement. [ 59 ] [ 60 ] Media reports linked Fedorov's removal to his conflict with the commander-in-chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine Oleksandr Syrskyi .
